C1301.title: Thousands of Google Cloud API Keys Exposed, Enabling Unauthorized Access to Gemini Services
C1301.summary: Truffle Security discovered nearly 3,000 Google Cloud API keys publicly exposed due to embedding in client-side code. When users enable the Gemini API in a Google Cloud project, existing billing keys automatically gain access to Gemini endpoints without warning, allowing attackers to access uploaded files, cached data, and generate massive bills.

references.title: Thousands of Google Cloud API Keys Leaked, Can Be Abused to Access Gemini Services
